Absolutely no photorealism, 3D render or realistic oil painting. Deliberate coherent anatomy, five fingers on any visible human hand, sound object interactions. Original design, no existing franchise characters. Thoroughly redesign this character as O SILENCIADOR, an imposing infernal SUPPRESSOR OF VOICES of SILENCIO (deliberate suppression, omission), with a unique non-human spiritual presence. Preserve mature male, shaved head and broad facial proportions as a distant identity cue; replace the friendly monk and headphones. Skin slate ash-gray, narrow pale teal eyes with normal clear iris contours, severe heavy brow, no beard. His lower face is covered by a rigid dark iron ritual half-mask with ONE narrow vertical teal seam; no headset or ear discs. A very tall rectangular black collar, charcoal sleeved vestments, deep desaturated teal sash, tiny antique brass clamps. One broken rectangular iron seal floats behind neck, no circular halo. Visible upper face, eyes and mask dominate three-quarter close portrait. Distant abandoned hall with pillars swallowing sound; faint teal soundwave is absorbed into black space. Pure anime, formidable restrained entity, no extra horns, no gore.

O ANFITRIAO DO DESAMPARO, Inferno/Silencio. Tall gaunt MALE humanoid entity, long narrow pale-gray face, sunken cobalt eyes, straight charcoal hair slicked back with ONE white central streak. Tall rigid rectangular black coat collar, long ink-black spectral tailcoat with cobalt lining, antique brass keyhole clasp at sternum and ONE broken-key pendant. He is a coherent humanoid spiritual entity whose power manifests as denied shelter, empty corridors and isolation; never a chair, room-object or building creature. PORTA DO DESAMPARO, personal invulnerability. The SAME gaunt host stands ALONE midway through one thin upright doorway made of ink-black shadow and cobalt edges. He leans backward across its threshold as a pale incoming strike passes harmlessly in the foreground. Clear three-quarter medium framing, his face remains visible with white hair streak and blue eyes, one gloved hand gently closes the shadow door by a coherent brass handle. Long tailcoat follows the movement, cobalt lining visible. No allies, no room as a body, no cut-off limbs, no giant shield bubble.
